events.title: OVERDUE Demo Update: Night 4 Is Open
events.summary: Night 4 is open.Just in time for Steam Next Fest, the free OVERDUE demo now covers the first four nights at Bellweather Library. We spent the last few weeks playtesting in co-op, and most of this update came straight out of those sessions.Here's what's new:A fourth night. The demo now runs through Night 4, with a new ending waiting when you clock out. If you finished the old demo, start a fresh run to see it.Full controller support.
